keyPhrases.text: nothing great can come of mediocre material
accomplished cast and sparkling design and direction
charms of this rollicking pastiche are otherwise intermittent
often feels like being stuck for too long in front of an olde-worlde department-store window display
half-baked whodunit devoid of psychological complexity

reasoning: Despite praising individual performances and production elements, the review is fundamentally negative about the material itself, calling it 'mediocre' with 'intermittent' charms and comparing the experience to being 'stuck' in a window display. The criticism outweighs the praise.
